schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: THE SHARED GATE MACHINERY every Learning Block imports — built once, the single-door move: skills declare contracts, they do not build refusal. Five organs: the DOOR (a declarable input contract; insufficient shape refused with EVERY lack named on the first pass, the refusal itself traced); the TRACE (every firing recorded, green included, consumer-typed at write — debug|training|tree-primary; no consumer named, no trace written; debug records expire at 30 days, swept by the NEXT WRITE — the write is the event, nothing resident, no clock); the FINDING (the exit-time bullet list, every bullet stratum-tagged code|tree|hex, and hex mintable ONLY via the injected seam — provenance cannot be invented); the VERDICT (Akien's approve/disprove/question captured with his words verbatim as a gate-record conforming to CairnCommons/learning/'s v0 format — the sole write path into that store from this component; approvals recorded with the same fidelity as disprovals, because greens are the denominator); the DIAL (a pure projection over the trace: firings, send-backs, approvals, disproves, questions, match rate — computed on read, stores nothing, mutates nothing).
why: Akien, 2026-08-01, the morning the design settled: 'our workflow itself must have the same hard gates, built of learning blocks, everywhere... learning blocks can send a task or whatever back if the inputs are not sufficient AT ALL STEPS. that has been the problem all along. when we have that, there's nothing for you to skate with.' And the gate mechanism, his verbatim: 'we start with me owning all gates and i approve the pass... a bullet list finding from an inspector for that step that learns what --I-- will gate. eventually i delegate it.' The Leah amendment closed the loop's arithmetic: 'even not-surprising-green-feedback is a metricable feedback' — surprise routes the errors up, greens make the rates computable. One primitive rather than N bespoke gates is the db_domain pattern; the full arc, challenge pass, and settlement: CairnCommons/notes/held-learning-blocks-everywhere.json.
invoke: Import: `from cairn.learning_block import learning_block as lb` — `lb.declare_contract(block, {field: why})` · `lb.fire_door(contract, payload)` (traced pass, or DoorRefused carrying every lack) · `lb.write_trace(block, event, consumer, data)` · `lb.emit_finding(block, bullets, hex_source=None)` · `lb.record_verdict(gate, finding, signal, verbatim, session=...)` · `lb.dial(block)`. Prove: `python3 cairn/learning_block/proofs/test_learning_block.py` (exit 0 = green). Roots injectable: `CAIRN_LB_TRACE_ROOT` (traces; default ~/.cairn/devices/learning_block/0/traces) and `CAIRN_ROOTS_PARENT` (commons discovery for the verdict store) — every proof call passes explicit roots and never touches the live stores.
for_whom: AKIEN is the gate — the finding's bullet list is written for his eyes, his approve/disprove/question is the input the verdict organ exists to capture, and the dial is what he reads to delegate. SKILLS are the callers (each migrated skill fires the door, traces, emits its finding — children b/c of skills-migrate-one-blow). The learning store's future fold is the training pairs' downstream reader.
node_class: code-seam — the machinery is the code, one address (ticket learning-block-primitive, child a of skills-migrate-one-blow). What it enables is the Learning Block ANATOMY, which lives in the skills that import it.
how_it_learns: The component itself doesn't — it is deliberately dumb machinery, and that is the design: 'it can if it starts with and is trained from me' means the LEARNING is the accumulation of Akien's verdict records in CairnCommons/learning/, which this component writes but never interprets. What learns is the per-gate record corpus (each verdict pair teaches the gate it fired at), read later by the store's fold and, eventually, by trained inspectors. The dial's match rate is the learning made visible; the component just counts.
entry: FRESH build 2026-08-01 under the full chain (/intent -> /challenge -> /sorted -> /chart -> /sail, the first voyage to run every link since the chain was named). In-house precedent composed, cited not copied: the learning store's v0 gate-record format (learning/README.md — conformed to field-by-field, not forked); the chokepoint's refuse-before-record + loud-named-exceptions grammar (cairn/base/transitions.py); needs.py's named-lack refusal door; the ruling gate's first-pass completeness (refuse with every reason at once) and its confirmed-by-his-words rule (a verdict without Akien's verbatim is refused — the bare-confirmed lesson); logger_for_bash's write-fired amortized retention; cairnmap/needs' pure-projection views.
state_and_history: history.json + state.json beside this charter, written only by the chokepoint's journaled crossings (BUILDME crossed 2026-08-01 under the claiming chart; the ticket's own state string carries the same cursor).
filed_edges: (a) 'unused in 30 days' is cut as AGE-based expiry in v0 (30 days since write) — true use-tracking (a read refreshing the clock) would make reads mutate, which the dial's mutate-nothing falsifier forbids; if real debugging shows young-but-dead traces piling up, the refinement is a separate read-door with explicit touch marks, not a weakening of the dial
(b) no skill declares a contract yet — the door has machinery and no tenants until child b (/intent migrates first); the contract SHAPE is this build's, the declarations are the migration's

(c) the delegation path (inspector rules, Akien audits) is deliberately unbuilt — nothing is delegated on day one by design; it lands when the first dial crosses Akien's threshold (the ticket's horizon)
(d) the hex seam points at inference_domain and wires nothing — the sole-path law owns the wiring; a live hex_source arrives with the inspector work, behind that door

(e) 'dial' collides by name with cairn/chart/dial.py (provenance fractions — different object, same word); flagged at survey, kept because each is honest in its own domain and the map renders both charters; a rename is minted loudly or not at all

(f) match_rate is approvals/(approvals+disproves) — the v0 reading of 'prediction match': an approve IS a confirmed prediction per the settled anatomy; a finer per-bullet match waits for structured predictions, which wait for trained inspectors
gates: proof gate — proofs/test_learning_block.py, runnable bare (python3) and under the tester. Durability gate: not done until proven AND committed (git). The gates this component IMPLEMENTS (door/verdict) are owned by Akien wherever they fire — this code is the mechanism, never the authority.
falsifier: RED, by physics, on any of: (1) the door passes an input missing a declared-required field, or refuses naming fewer than all lacks; (2) a firing leaves no trace — including a GREEN one (the denominator must exist), or a typeless trace lands; (3) expiry deletes a record under 30 days, touches a non-debug record, or requires anything resident; (4) a verdict is recorded without its bullet-list context, without Akien's verbatim words, or outside the store's v0 nesting; an approval dropped as not-worth-recording; (5) the dial stores state, disagrees with a hand-count, or a read mutates anything; (6) a bullet lands untagged, tagged outside code|tree|hex, or tagged hex without the injected seam (invented provenance); (7) a second write path into CairnCommons/learning/ appears in this component.
owner: CC owns the learning_block code + its proofs and gates writes to them. AKIEN owns every gate the machinery serves — the verdict is his act, recorded with his words, and delegation happens only through his act, never ambiently (Law 6). The trace berth is instance-space (runtime); the verdict records belong to the learning store's own charter once written.
traces_to: Law 2 (CP1-CP6 hold in the process that builds the system — this puts the process's own steps under gates)
Law 3 (a verdict is a recorded measurement; greens are the denominator — the Leah rule)
Law 4 (send-back is physics at the door, not discipline; expiry is write-fired, never a clock)
Law 6 (one owner per gate — Akien's, until his act delegates; sole write path into the learning store)
Law 7 (a refusal names every lack; a green record is as permanent as a red one)
founding intention learns-its-gates (this is that store's writer, conforming to its v0 format)

proof: proofs/test_learning_block.py — 17 teeth, defect-first, injected roots (live stores never touched): typed round-trip; typeless refusal writes NOTHING; green/red equal durability; write-fired expiry (31-day debug gone at next write, 29-day and old-training spared); nothing-resident source scan; two-lacks-one-refusal all named; refusal AND pass traced, input unmutated by hash; hollow contract refused; finding emit-retrieve equality on the closed strata; untagged/invented strata refused NAMING the bullet; hex only via the seam (hand-hex refused, stub tagged, absent seam yields zero); import-scan scoped to import lines (the leak-scan lesson); v0 store conformance field-by-field; approve/disprove parity with the asymmetric confidence moves; verdict refused without finding/words/known signal; dial equals hand-count and moves exactly with new evidence; match_rate None before any verdict; dial read mutates nothing (mtime_ns).
provenance: Cast at /sorted and built the same day (2026-08-01) — the morning Akien named the gap ('we're not dogfooding our most important element in the thing we do EVERY SINGLE DAY'), the design settled at his gate, and the first voyage ran the ENTIRE chain: charted (seven berths, validate-20260801T103426 claiming the ticket), BUILDME journaled through the chokepoint's entry gate, built in triage order (trace -> door -> finding -> verdict -> dial -> seam -> proofs). First-pass red count: one — the import-scan tooth caught its own crudeness (whole-source grep firing on the docstring's honest mention of inference_domain), fixed by scoping to import lines, the leak-scan lesson re-learned in miniature.
